question: The points $P$ and $Q$ have position vectors $\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+3\hat{k}$ and $7\hat{i}+4\hat{j}-3\hat{k}$, respectively. A point $R$ divides $PQ$ internally in the ratio $2:1$.(a) Find the position vector and coordinates of $R$.(b) Determine the scalar components of $\overrightarrow{PR}$ and $\overrightarrow{RQ}$.(c) Verify from these components that $PR\:RQ=2:1$.

options.A:
(a) $\vec{r}=5\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-\hat{k}$, $R=(5,2,-1)$
(b) Scalar components of $\overrightarrow{PR}$ are $(4,4,-4)$ and of $\overrightarrow{RQ}$ are $(2,2,-2)$.
(c) $\overrightarrow{PR}=2\overrightarrow{RQ}$, so $PR:RQ=2:1$.
